parsed.note_claim: The page is a fake Cloudflare CAPTCHA using the ClickFix/TerminalFix technique that tricks victims into running malicious PowerShell commands to install malware.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Microsoft Threat Intelligence said a campaign it calls TerminalFix, a variant of the ClickFix technique, uses compromised websites to display a fake Cloudflare verification prompt. Victims are tricked into copying and running a malicious PowerShell command
parsed.reason: The page directly describes the fake Cloudflare CAPTCHA, the TerminalFix/ClickFix technique, and the malicious PowerShell execution, matching the note's claims.
